description: Doomcaller's Mantle Level 60 Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Qiraji Bindings of Dominance - Idol of the Sage x 2 - Bronze Scarab x 5 - Bone Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
